# sigma_saml_service_providers (Data Source)

Lists SAML service provider IDs for the organization (Beta API). Service providers are read-only; manage their certificates with sigma_saml_service_provider_certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_saml_service_providers" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) SAML service provider IDs.
